hints.title: Problem Analysis
hints.text: We need to evaluate the expression ((a^b % 10)^c) % m for each tuple [a, b, c, m].

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Since b and c can be up to 10^3, use fast modular exponentiation to prevent large integer overflows and compute in logarithmic time.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy
hints.text: In Python, pow(base, exp, mod) natively performs modular exponentiation in O(log exp). Check if the result equals target.
